Doctors.Title: User Authentication and Account Management
Doctors.Description: Enable doctors to register and log in with OTP mobile verification and email verification. Allow doctors to manage their profile information, including name, phone number, email, and profile picture.

User Stories.Title: Doctor Registration
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want to register with my name, email, phone number, and password so that I can create an account on the platform.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I am a doctor, when I provide my name, email, phone number, and password, then I should be able to create an account.
Given that I have registered, when I submit my details, then I should receive an email and OTP for verification.

User Stories.Title: Email Verification
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want to verify my email address so that I can confirm my account registration.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I have registered, when I receive an email with a verification link, then I should be able to click the link to verify my email address.
Given that I click the verification link, when my email is verified, then I should receive a confirmation message.

User Stories.Title: OTP Mobile Verification
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want to verify my phone number using an OTP so that I can secure my account.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I have registered, when I receive an OTP on my mobile phone, then I should be able to enter the OTP on the platform.
Given that I enter the correct OTP, when I submit it, then my phone number should be verified.

User Stories.Title: Doctor Login
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want to log in using my registered email and password so that I can access my account.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I have registered and verified my account, when I enter my email and password, then I should be able to log in.
Given that I enter incorrect login details, when I attempt to log in, then I should receive an error message.

User Stories.Title: Profile Management
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want to manage my profile information, including name, phone number, email, and profile picture, so that I can keep my account details up to date.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I am logged in, when I navigate to the profile management section, then I should be able to view my current profile information.
Given that I am in the profile management section, when I update my name, phone number, email, or profile picture, then the changes should be saved and reflected in my profile.

User Stories.Title: Password Reset
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want to reset my password if I forget it so that I can regain access to my account.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I am on the login page, when I click the 'Forgot Password' link, then I should be prompted to enter my registered email.
Given that I enter my registered email, when I submit it, then I should receive a password reset link via email.
Given that I receive the password reset link, when I click the link and enter a new password, then my password should be updated, and I should be able to log in with the new password.

Doctors.Title: Patient Management
Doctors.Description: Provide doctors with a list of patients who have granted access via QR code. Allow doctors to access detailed profiles, including visit and consultation histories, of each patient.

User Stories.Title: View List of Patients
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want to view a list of patients who have granted access via QR code so that I can easily manage and access their profiles.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I am logged in as a doctor, when I navigate to the patient management section, I should see a list of patients who have granted access via QR code.
Each patient entry in the list should display the patient's name and a brief summary of their latest visit.
The list should be sortable by patient name and date of last visit.

User Stories.Title: Access Detailed Patient Profiles
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want to access detailed profiles of patients so that I can review their medical history and provide better care.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I am logged in as a doctor, when I click on a patient from the list, I should be taken to a detailed profile page of that patient.
The profile page should display the patient's personal information, visit history, and consultation history.
The profile page should allow me to navigate back to the list of patients.

User Stories.Title: View Visit History
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want to view the visit history of a patient so that I can understand their past medical interactions and conditions.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I am on a patient's profile page, when I click on the 'Visit History' tab, I should see a chronological list of all past visits.
Each visit entry should include the date, summary of the visit, and any relevant notes or observations.
I should be able to click on each visit entry to view more detailed information.

User Stories.Title: View Consultation History
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want to view the consultation history of a patient so that I can review past consultations and their outcomes.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I am on a patient's profile page, when I click on the 'Consultation History' tab, I should see a chronological list of all past consultations.
Each consultation entry should include the date, summary of the consultation, and any generated reports.
I should be able to click on each consultation entry to view more detailed information.

User Stories.Title: Start New Consultation
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want to start a new consultation by scanning a patient's QR code so that the consultation is linked to the correct patient.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I am logged in as a doctor, when I click on the 'Start New Consultation' button, I should be prompted to scan a patient's QR code.
Upon scanning the QR code, the system should link the consultation to the correct patient and take me to a new consultation page.
The new consultation page should allow me to input notes, access patient history, and generate a consultation report.

User Stories.Title: AI-Assisted Consultation
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want AI assistance during consultations so that I can receive real-time analysis and summarization of the conversation.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I am in a consultation session, the AI should provide real-time analysis and summarization of the conversation.
The AI should prompt for specific patient information or insights based on the conversation context.
The AI should generate a draft consultation report that I can review, edit, and approve.

User Stories.Title: Approve and Share Consultation Reports
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want to approve and share consultation reports with patients so that they have access to the outcomes of their consultations.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I have completed a consultation, the system should generate a consultation report.
I should be able to review, edit, and approve the consultation report.
Once approved, the report should be shared with the patient and stored in their consultation history.

Doctors.Title: Consultation Process
Doctors.Description: Enable doctors to start a new consultation session by scanning the patient's QR code to link the consultation to the patient. Provide AI assistance during consultations for real-time analysis and summarization. Allow doctors to generate, review, edit, and approve consultation reports, and share approved reports with patients.

User Stories.Title: Start New Consultation by Scanning QR Code
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want to start a new consultation session by scanning the patient's QR code so that I can link the consultation to the patient's profile.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the doctor dashboard, when I click on 'Start New Consultation', then I should be prompted to scan the patient's QR code.
When the QR code is successfully scanned, then the consultation session should be linked to the patient's profile.
If the QR code is invalid, then I should receive an error message indicating the issue.

User Stories.Title: AI Assistance During Consultation
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want AI assistance during consultations for real-time analysis and summarization so that I can make informed decisions quickly.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am in an active consultation session, when I interact with the patient, then the AI should provide real-time analysis and summarization of the conversation.
When the AI detects key medical information, then it should highlight and summarize this information for my review.
If the AI is unable to provide analysis, then I should receive a notification indicating the issue.

User Stories.Title: Generate Consultation Report
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want to generate a consultation report automatically from the AI analysis so that I can save time on documentation.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I have completed a consultation session, when I click on 'Generate Report', then the AI should create a structured report based on the consultation.
The generated report should include key points, summaries, and any flagged issues discussed during the consultation.
If the report generation fails, then I should receive an error message indicating the issue.

User Stories.Title: Review and Edit Consultation Report
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want to review and edit the consultation report generated by the AI so that I can ensure its accuracy before approval.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a consultation report has been generated, when I click on 'Review Report', then I should be able to view the report in detail.
When I click on 'Edit Report', then I should be able to make changes to the report content.
If I make changes, then the system should save the edited report and notify me of the successful update.

User Stories.Title: Approve and Share Consultation Report
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want to approve the consultation report and share it with the patient so that the patient can have access to their medical information.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I have reviewed and edited the consultation report, when I click on 'Approve Report', then the report should be marked as approved.
When the report is approved, then it should be automatically shared with the patient via their profile.
If the sharing process fails, then I should receive an error message indicating the issue.

Doctors.Title: Interactive AI for Doctor
Doctors.Description: Allow doctors to prompt the AI agent associated with a patient to retrieve specific information or insights from the patient's conversation history. Use the AI to retrieve and summarize relevant patient history to aid the doctor during consultations.

User Stories.Title: Prompt AI for Specific Patient Information
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want to prompt the AI to retrieve specific information from a patient's conversation history so that I can quickly access relevant details during consultations.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the doctor dashboard, when I select a patient, then I should see an option to prompt the AI for specific information.
When I enter a query, the AI should retrieve and display the relevant information from the patient's conversation history.
The retrieved information should be accurate and relevant to the query entered.

User Stories.Title: AI Summarization of Patient History
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want the AI to summarize a patient's conversation history so that I can get a quick overview of the patient's past interactions and medical history.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am viewing a patient's profile, when I click on the 'Summarize History' button, then the AI should generate a summary of the patient's conversation history.
The summary should include key points such as symptoms, medical conditions, and any other relevant information.
The summary should be concise and easy to read.

User Stories.Title: Real-Time AI Assistance During Consultations
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want the AI to provide real-time assistance during consultations so that I can make more informed decisions based on the patient's conversation history.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am in a consultation session, when I ask the AI for specific insights, then the AI should provide real-time responses based on the patient's conversation history.
The AI should be able to handle multiple queries during the consultation without significant delays.
The information provided by the AI should be accurate and relevant to the ongoing consultation.

User Stories.Title: Access AI-Generated Patient Summaries
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want to access AI-generated summaries of patient histories so that I can review them before or during consultations.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am on the doctor dashboard, when I select a patient, then I should see an option to view AI-generated summaries of the patient's history.
The summaries should be up-to-date and include all relevant information from the patient's conversation history.
I should be able to download or print the summaries for offline review.

User Stories.Title: AI-Driven Insights for Patient Management
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want the AI to provide insights based on patient conversation histories so that I can better manage my patients and prioritize their needs.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am viewing the patient list, when I click on a patient flagged by the AI, then I should see detailed insights and recommendations based on the patient's conversation history.
The AI should categorize patients based on the urgency and type of their medical needs.
The insights provided should help me prioritize consultations and follow-up actions.

Doctors.Title: Patient Flags
Doctors.Description: Provide a feature for doctors to view a list of patients categorized by flags based on the patients' onboarding responses. This helps doctors prioritize and manage patient care effectively.

User Stories.Title: View Patient Flags Dashboard
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want to view a dashboard that lists patients categorized by flags based on their onboarding responses so that I can quickly prioritize and manage patient care.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I am logged in as a doctor, when I navigate to the patient flags dashboard, I should see a list of patients categorized by different flags.
Each flag category should be clearly labeled and patients should be listed under their respective categories.
The dashboard should be accessible from the main doctor dashboard.

User Stories.Title: Filter Patients by Flag Category
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want to filter the list of patients by specific flag categories so that I can focus on a particular group of patients.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I am on the patient flags dashboard, when I select a specific flag category, I should only see patients who fall under that category.
The filter should be easy to apply and remove, allowing for quick changes between categories.

User Stories.Title: View Detailed Patient Information from Flags Dashboard
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want to click on a patient from the flags dashboard to view their detailed profile and historical data so that I can make informed decisions about their care.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I am on the patient flags dashboard, when I click on a patient's name, I should be redirected to their detailed profile page.
The profile page should include the patient's visit history, consultation history, and any relevant notes or summaries.

User Stories.Title: Update Patient Flags Based on New Onboarding Responses
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want patient flags to be automatically updated based on new onboarding responses so that the categorization remains accurate and up-to-date.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that a patient completes a new onboarding process, when their responses are submitted, their flag category should be updated accordingly.
The updated flag should reflect on the patient flags dashboard in real-time.

User Stories.Title: Notification for Critical Flags
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want to receive notifications for patients who are flagged as critical based on their onboarding responses so that I can address urgent cases promptly.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that a patient is flagged as critical, when I log in to the platform, I should receive a notification highlighting the critical flag.
The notification should include the patient's name and a brief summary of the critical issue.

User Stories.Title: Export Patient Flags Report
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want to export a report of patients categorized by flags so that I can review and share the information offline or with other healthcare professionals.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I am on the patient flags dashboard, when I click on the export button, I should be able to download a report in PDF or CSV format.
The report should include all patients and their respective flag categories, along with any relevant notes or summaries.

Doctors.Title: Notifications and Alerts
Doctors.Description: Send email notifications to doctors for important actions such as registration, verification, and report approvals. Ensure timely communication of critical updates and actions.

User Stories.Title: Email Notification for Doctor Registration
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want to receive an email notification upon successful registration so that I am informed that my account has been created.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a doctor has successfully registered, when the registration process is completed, then an email notification is sent to the doctor's registered email address.
The email should include a welcome message and a confirmation of successful registration.

User Stories.Title: Email Notification for Doctor Verification
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want to receive an email notification upon successful account verification so that I am informed that my account is now verified.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a doctor has successfully verified their account, when the verification process is completed, then an email notification is sent to the doctor's registered email address.
The email should include a confirmation of successful verification and any next steps if applicable.

User Stories.Title: Email Notification for Report Approval
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want to receive an email notification when a consultation report is approved so that I am informed of the report's status.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a consultation report has been approved, when the approval process is completed, then an email notification is sent to the doctor's registered email address.
The email should include details of the approved report, including patient name, consultation date, and a summary of the report.

User Stories.Title: Email Notification for Critical Updates
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want to receive email notifications for critical updates and actions so that I am always informed of important changes or actions required.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a critical update or action is required, when the update or action is identified, then an email notification is sent to the doctor's registered email address.
The email should include details of the critical update or action required, including any deadlines or steps needed to address the update.

User Stories.Title: Email Notification for New Patient Registration
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want to receive an email notification when a new patient registers and associates with me so that I am aware of new patients under my care.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a new patient has registered and associated with a doctor, when the association process is completed, then an email notification is sent to the doctor's registered email address.
The email should include the patient's name, registration date, and any initial information provided by the patient.

Doctors.Title: Data Security and Privacy
Doctors.Description: Implement robust access control mechanisms to protect patient data. Ensure all sensitive data is encrypted in transit and at rest to comply with Canadian Laws and Quebec Loi 25 laws.

User Stories.Title: Doctor Account Security
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want my account to be secured with OTP and email verification so that I can ensure that only I have access to my account.
AcceptanceCriteria: Doctors must verify their email during registration.
Doctors must verify their phone number using OTP during registration.
Doctors must log in using their registered email and password.

User Stories.Title: Secure Data Access
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want to access patient data securely so that I can ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information.
AcceptanceCriteria: All patient data must be encrypted in transit using HTTPS.
All patient data must be encrypted at rest in the database.
Access to patient data should be restricted to authorized users only.

User Stories.Title: Role-Based Access Control
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want role-based access control mechanisms so that only authorized personnel can access specific data and functionalities.
AcceptanceCriteria: Doctors can only access patient data for patients who have shared their QR code.
Doctors can only view and edit consultation reports for their patients.
Access logs should be maintained to track who accessed what data and when.

User Stories.Title: Secure Consultation Reports
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want consultation reports to be securely stored and accessed so that patient information remains confidential.
AcceptanceCriteria: Consultation reports must be encrypted at rest in the database.
Only the doctor who conducted the consultation and the patient can access the consultation report.
Consultation reports should be accessible only after the doctor has approved them.

User Stories.Title: Data Encryption Compliance
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want the platform to comply with Canadian Laws and Quebec Loi 25 laws so that I can be assured that patient data is handled legally and securely.
AcceptanceCriteria: All sensitive data must be encrypted in transit and at rest.
The platform must provide documentation proving compliance with Canadian Laws and Quebec Loi 25 laws.
Regular audits should be conducted to ensure ongoing compliance.

User Stories.Title: Secure QR Code Access
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want to securely scan patient QR codes to access their profiles and histories so that I can ensure that only authorized access is granted.
AcceptanceCriteria: QR codes must be securely generated and encrypted.
Only authorized doctors can scan and access patient data using QR codes.
Access logs should record each instance of QR code scanning and data access.

User Stories.Title: Notification of Data Access
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want to receive notifications when patient data is accessed so that I can monitor and ensure data security.
AcceptanceCriteria: Doctors receive email notifications when patient data is accessed.
Notifications include details of who accessed the data and when.
Doctors can review access logs through their dashboard.

AI System.Title: AI-Driven Onboarding
AI System.Description: Develop an AI agent to interact with patients during the onboarding process. The AI will dynamically ask questions based on the conversation context and store all responses in a structured format.

User Stories.Title: Initialize AI Agent
User Stories.Description: As a developer, I want to initialize an AI agent so that it can interact with patients during the onboarding process.
AcceptanceCriteria: AI agent is successfully initialized and ready to interact with patients.
AI agent can be invoked via API endpoints.

User Stories.Title: Dynamic Question Generation
User Stories.Description: As an AI system, I want to generate dynamic questions based on the conversation context so that the onboarding process is personalized for each patient.
AcceptanceCriteria: AI agent generates relevant questions based on the patient's previous responses.
Questions are contextually appropriate and follow a logical flow.

User Stories.Title: Store Responses in Structured Format
User Stories.Description: As an AI system, I want to store all patient responses in a structured format so that the data can be easily retrieved and analyzed later.
AcceptanceCriteria: All patient responses are stored in a structured format in the database.
Data storage follows the defined schema and is accessible via API.

User Stories.Title: Conversation Context Management
User Stories.Description: As an AI system, I want to maintain the context of the conversation so that I can provide relevant and coherent responses throughout the onboarding process.
AcceptanceCriteria: AI agent maintains the context of the conversation across multiple interactions.
Context management is robust and handles edge cases such as interruptions or topic changes.

User Stories.Title: Voice and Text Interaction
User Stories.Description: As an AI system, I want to support both voice and text interactions so that patients can choose their preferred mode of communication.
AcceptanceCriteria: AI agent can handle voice input and convert it to text using OpenAI API.
AI agent can respond in both text and voice formats.

User Stories.Title: Conversation Summarization
User Stories.Description: As an AI system, I want to summarize long conversations so that key information is easily accessible for both patients and doctors.
AcceptanceCriteria: AI agent generates accurate and concise summaries of long conversations.
Summaries are stored in the database and accessible via API.

User Stories.Title: Emotional and Physical Well-being Analysis
User Stories.Description: As an AI system, I want to analyze conversations for emotional and physical well-being so that I can provide insights to doctors.
AcceptanceCriteria: AI agent analyzes conversations for indicators of emotional and physical well-being.
Analysis results are stored in the database and accessible via API.

User Stories.Title: Secure Data Transmission
User Stories.Description: As an AI system, I want to ensure that all data transmitted during the onboarding process is encrypted so that patient information remains secure.
AcceptanceCriteria: All data in transit is encrypted using industry-standard protocols.
Encryption is verified through security tests and audits.

User Stories.Title: Integration with Backend Systems
User Stories.Description: As a developer, I want to integrate the AI agent with backend systems so that patient data can be stored and retrieved efficiently.
AcceptanceCriteria: AI agent is integrated with the backend database (MongoDB).
API endpoints for data storage and retrieval are functional and tested.

User Stories.Title: Compliance with Data Privacy Laws
User Stories.Description: As an AI system, I want to comply with Canadian and Quebec Loi 25 data privacy laws so that patient information is handled legally and ethically.
AcceptanceCriteria: Data handling processes comply with Canadian and Quebec Loi 25 laws.
Regular audits and reviews are conducted to ensure ongoing compliance.

AI System.Title: Conversational AI for Patients
AI System.Description: Implement a chat interface that allows patients to interact with an AI agent via text or voice. The AI will have access to the entire conversation history to provide informed responses and analyze conversations for emotional and physical well-being.

User Stories.Title: Text-Based Chat Interface
User Stories.Description: As a patient, I want to interact with an AI agent via a text-based chat interface so that I can ask questions and receive responses in real-time.
AcceptanceCriteria: The chat interface should be accessible from the patient dashboard.
Patients should be able to type messages and receive text responses from the AI agent.
The AI agent should have access to the entire conversation history to provide informed responses.

User Stories.Title: Voice-Based Chat Interface
User Stories.Description: As a patient, I want to interact with an AI agent via a voice-based chat interface so that I can communicate more naturally.
AcceptanceCriteria: The voice chat interface should be accessible from the patient dashboard.
Patients should be able to speak to the AI agent and receive voice responses.
The AI agent should convert voice input to text and text responses to voice using OpenAI API.

User Stories.Title: Conversation History Access
User Stories.Description: As an AI system, I want to access the entire conversation history so that I can provide informed responses to patients.
AcceptanceCriteria: The AI system should be able to retrieve and store all past conversations with the patient.
The AI system should use the conversation history to generate context-aware responses.
The conversation history should be encrypted in transit and at rest to comply with Canadian Laws and Quebec Loi 25.

User Stories.Title: Emotional and Physical Well-being Analysis
User Stories.Description: As an AI system, I want to analyze conversations for emotional and physical well-being so that I can provide relevant insights and support.
AcceptanceCriteria: The AI system should analyze text and voice inputs for emotional cues using sentiment analysis.
The AI system should identify keywords and phrases related to physical well-being.
The analysis results should be stored securely and be accessible to both patients and doctors.

User Stories.Title: Conversation Summarization
User Stories.Description: As an AI system, I want to summarize long conversations so that I can provide concise and relevant information to patients and doctors.
AcceptanceCriteria: The AI system should summarize conversations that exceed a predefined word count.
The summaries should capture key points and important information from the conversation.
Summarized conversations should be stored in the database and accessible to patients and doctors.

User Stories.Title: Real-Time Response Generation
User Stories.Description: As an AI system, I want to generate real-time responses during patient interactions so that I can maintain an engaging and helpful conversation flow.
AcceptanceCriteria: The AI system should respond to patient queries within a few seconds.
Responses should be contextually relevant and based on the conversation history.
The AI system should handle multiple simultaneous conversations efficiently.

User Stories.Title: Data Security and Privacy
User Stories.Description: As an AI system, I want to ensure data security and privacy so that patient information is protected.
AcceptanceCriteria: All data in transit and at rest should be encrypted.
Access to conversation data should be restricted to authorized users only.
The system should comply with Canadian Laws and Quebec Loi 25 regarding data security and privacy.

User Stories.Title: AI Model Integration
User Stories.Description: As an AI system, I want to integrate transformer models for conversation analysis and response generation so that I can provide advanced conversational capabilities.
AcceptanceCriteria: The AI system should use transformer models for understanding and generating text.
The models should be trained to handle patient onboarding, conversation analysis, and report generation.
The integration should be optimized for real-time performance.

AI System.Title: AI Assistance for Doctors
AI System.Description: Provide AI assistance for doctors during consultations to analyze and summarize conversations in real-time. The AI will help retrieve relevant patient history and generate structured consultation reports.

User Stories.Title: Real-Time Conversation Analysis
User Stories.Description: As an AI System, I want to analyze doctor-patient conversations in real-time so that I can provide immediate insights and summaries to assist the doctor.
AcceptanceCriteria: The AI system should be able to process live audio or text input from consultations.
The AI system should generate real-time summaries of the ongoing conversation.
The AI system should highlight key points and important information during the conversation.

User Stories.Title: Retrieve Relevant Patient History
User Stories.Description: As an AI System, I want to retrieve relevant patient history during consultations so that I can provide contextually accurate information to the doctor.
AcceptanceCriteria: The AI system should access the patient's historical data from the database.
The AI system should identify and retrieve relevant information based on the current conversation context.
The AI system should present the retrieved information in a concise and understandable format for the doctor.

User Stories.Title: Generate Structured Consultation Reports
User Stories.Description: As an AI System, I want to generate structured consultation reports so that doctors can review, edit, and approve them easily.
AcceptanceCriteria: The AI system should compile a structured report based on the conversation analysis and retrieved patient history.
The report should include sections for key points, diagnosis, treatment plan, and follow-up actions.
The report should be editable by the doctor before final approval.
The final approved report should be stored in the database and shared with the patient.

User Stories.Title: AI Prompting for Specific Information
User Stories.Description: As an AI System, I want to allow doctors to prompt me for specific patient information or insights so that I can provide targeted assistance during consultations.
AcceptanceCriteria: The AI system should recognize and respond to specific prompts from the doctor.
The AI system should retrieve and present the requested information accurately and promptly.
The AI system should log all prompts and responses for future reference.

User Stories.Title: Voice-to-Text and Text-to-Voice Integration
User Stories.Description: As an AI System, I want to convert voice inputs to text and vice versa so that I can facilitate seamless communication between the doctor and the patient.
AcceptanceCriteria: The AI system should accurately convert live voice inputs to text in real-time.
The AI system should convert text responses to voice outputs when required.
The system should handle different accents and speech patterns effectively.

User Stories.Title: Summarize Long Conversations
User Stories.Description: As an AI System, I want to summarize long conversations so that doctors can quickly review the main points without going through the entire conversation.
AcceptanceCriteria: The AI system should identify and extract key points from long conversations.
The summary should be concise and cover all critical aspects of the conversation.
The summary should be stored in the database and accessible to both the doctor and the patient.

User Stories.Title: Emotional and Physical Well-being Analysis
User Stories.Description: As an AI System, I want to analyze conversations for emotional and physical well-being so that I can provide insights into the patient's overall health status.
AcceptanceCriteria: The AI system should analyze the tone, sentiment, and content of the conversation.
The system should identify indicators of emotional and physical well-being.
The insights should be presented to the doctor in a clear and actionable format.

User Stories.Title: Secure Data Handling
User Stories.Description: As an AI System, I want to ensure secure data handling so that patient information is protected in compliance with Canadian Laws and Quebec Loi 25 laws.
AcceptanceCriteria: All data in transit and at rest should be encrypted.
Access to patient data should be restricted to authorized users only.
The system should log all access and modifications to patient data for audit purposes.

User Stories.Title: AI Model Training and Updates
User Stories.Description: As an AI System, I want to continuously train and update my models so that I can improve the accuracy and relevance of my analyses and summaries.
AcceptanceCriteria: The AI system should have a mechanism for periodic model training and updates.
The training data should include diverse and representative samples to improve model performance.
The system should validate and test new models before deploying them in the live environment.

AI System.Title: Transformer Model Integration
AI System.Description: Integrate transformer models for handling patient onboarding, summarizing conversation histories, and generating consultation reports. Ensure the models are trained and optimized for these specific tasks.

User Stories.Title: Train Transformer Model for Patient Onboarding
User Stories.Description: As an AI System, I want to train a transformer model specifically for patient onboarding so that it can dynamically interact with patients and collect relevant information.
AcceptanceCriteria: The transformer model should be trained on a dataset containing various patient onboarding scenarios.
The model should be able to ask dynamic questions based on the patient's responses.
The model should store all collected data in a structured format in the database.
The model should be able to handle both text and voice inputs.

User Stories.Title: Optimize Transformer Model for Conversation Summarization
User Stories.Description: As an AI System, I want to optimize the transformer model for summarizing patient-doctor conversations so that it can generate concise and accurate summaries.
AcceptanceCriteria: The transformer model should be trained on a dataset of patient-doctor conversations.
The model should be able to identify key points and generate a summary of the conversation.
The summary should be stored in the database and accessible to both patients and doctors.
The model should handle conversations of varying lengths and complexities.

User Stories.Title: Generate Consultation Reports Using Transformer Model
User Stories.Description: As an AI System, I want to generate consultation reports using the transformer model so that doctors can review, edit, and approve them for sharing with patients.
AcceptanceCriteria: The transformer model should be trained on a dataset of consultation reports.
The model should generate a structured report based on the consultation conversation.
The report should be editable by the doctor before approval.
Once approved, the report should be stored in the database and shared with the patient.

User Stories.Title: Integrate Voice-to-Text and Text-to-Voice Capabilities
User Stories.Description: As an AI System, I want to integrate voice-to-text and text-to-voice capabilities using OpenAI API so that patients and doctors can interact with the AI using voice commands.
AcceptanceCriteria: The system should convert voice inputs to text using OpenAI API.
The system should convert text responses to voice using OpenAI API.
The voice interactions should be seamless and have minimal latency.
The system should handle different accents and speech patterns accurately.

User Stories.Title: Store and Retrieve Conversation Histories
User Stories.Description: As an AI System, I want to store and retrieve conversation histories so that I can provide informed responses based on past interactions.
AcceptanceCriteria: All patient-AI and doctor-AI conversations should be stored in the database.
The system should retrieve relevant conversation histories when needed.
The retrieved histories should be used to provide context-aware responses.
The system should ensure data security and privacy compliance.

User Stories.Title: Analyze Conversations for Emotional and Physical Well-being
User Stories.Description: As an AI System, I want to analyze conversations for emotional and physical well-being so that I can provide valuable insights to doctors.
AcceptanceCriteria: The transformer model should be trained to detect emotional and physical cues from conversations.
The system should generate insights based on the analysis of these cues.
The insights should be presented to doctors in a summarized format.
The system should continuously improve its analysis capabilities through ongoing training.

AI System.Title: Voice and Text Processing
AI System.Description: Utilize OpenAI's API for voice-to-text, text-to-voice, and text generation functionalities. This will enable the AI to effectively interact with users and provide accurate responses.

User Stories.Title: Voice-to-Text Conversion
User Stories.Description: As an AI System, I want to convert user voice inputs to text using OpenAI's API so that I can process and understand user queries accurately.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a voice input from the user, when the AI system receives the input, then it should convert the voice to text using OpenAI's API.
The converted text should be accurate and reflect the user's spoken words.
The system should handle different accents and speech patterns effectively.

User Stories.Title: Text-to-Voice Conversion
User Stories.Description: As an AI System, I want to convert text responses to voice using OpenAI's API so that I can provide audible feedback to users.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a text response generated by the AI, when the AI system processes the text, then it should convert the text to voice using OpenAI's API.
The voice output should be clear and understandable.
The system should support multiple languages and adjust the voice tone based on the context of the response.

User Stories.Title: Text Generation for User Queries
User Stories.Description: As an AI System, I want to generate text responses to user queries using OpenAI's API so that I can provide relevant and accurate information.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a user query in text form, when the AI system processes the query, then it should generate a relevant and accurate text response using OpenAI's API.
The generated response should be contextually appropriate and address the user's query effectively.
The system should be able to handle follow-up questions and maintain context throughout the conversation.

User Stories.Title: Contextual Understanding and Response Generation
User Stories.Description: As an AI System, I want to maintain context throughout a conversation using OpenAI's API so that I can provide coherent and contextually relevant responses.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a series of user queries, when the AI system processes each query, then it should maintain the context of the conversation using OpenAI's API.
The responses should be coherent and relevant to the ongoing conversation.
The system should be able to reference previous parts of the conversation to provide more informed responses.

User Stories.Title: Error Handling for API Integration
User Stories.Description: As an AI System, I want to handle errors and exceptions from OpenAI's API gracefully so that I can ensure a smooth user experience.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given an error or exception from OpenAI's API, when the AI system encounters the error, then it should handle the error gracefully and provide a fallback response to the user.
The system should log the error details for further analysis and debugging.
The user should be informed of any issues in a user-friendly manner without exposing technical details.

User Stories.Title: Performance Optimization for API Calls
User Stories.Description: As an AI System, I want to optimize the performance of API calls to OpenAI so that I can provide quick and responsive interactions.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a user query or input, when the AI system makes an API call to OpenAI, then the response time should be minimized to ensure a quick interaction.
The system should implement caching mechanisms where appropriate to reduce redundant API calls.
The performance of the system should be monitored and optimized continuously to handle high volumes of user interactions efficiently.

User Stories.Title: Security and Privacy for API Data
User Stories.Description: As an AI System, I want to ensure the security and privacy of data exchanged with OpenAI's API so that I can comply with data protection regulations.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a user query or input, when the AI system sends data to OpenAI's API, then the data should be encrypted in transit.
The system should ensure that no sensitive user data is exposed or logged during the API interactions.
The AI system should comply with relevant data protection regulations, including Canadian Laws and Quebec Loi 25.

AI System.Title: AI-Driven Summarization and Analysis
AI System.Description: Implement logic for the AI to summarize long conversations and analyze them for key insights. This includes emotional and physical well-being, medical history, and other relevant factors.

User Stories.Title: Summarize Long Conversations
User Stories.Description: As an AI System, I want to summarize long conversations so that users can quickly understand the key points and insights from their interactions.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a conversation exceeding a predefined word count, when the AI processes the conversation, then it should generate a concise summary highlighting the main points.
The summary should include key topics discussed, important questions asked, and any significant responses.
The summary should be generated in real-time or near-real-time to ensure timely access for users.

User Stories.Title: Analyze Emotional Well-being
User Stories.Description: As an AI System, I want to analyze conversations for emotional well-being so that I can provide insights into the user's emotional state.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a conversation, when the AI processes the text, then it should identify and categorize emotional tones such as happiness, sadness, anger, and anxiety.
The AI should provide a summary of the emotional states detected throughout the conversation.
The emotional analysis should be accurate and validated against a predefined set of emotional indicators.

User Stories.Title: Analyze Physical Well-being
User Stories.Description: As an AI System, I want to analyze conversations for physical well-being so that I can provide insights into the user's physical health status.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a conversation, when the AI processes the text, then it should identify mentions of physical symptoms, conditions, and health concerns.
The AI should provide a summary of the physical health indicators detected throughout the conversation.
The physical well-being analysis should be accurate and validated against a predefined set of health indicators.

User Stories.Title: Extract Medical History
User Stories.Description: As an AI System, I want to extract relevant medical history from conversations so that I can provide a comprehensive overview of the user's health background.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a conversation, when the AI processes the text, then it should identify and extract information related to past medical conditions, treatments, and medications.
The extracted medical history should be organized in a structured format for easy access and review.
The AI should ensure that the extracted medical history is accurate and relevant to the user's health context.

User Stories.Title: Generate Key Insights
User Stories.Description: As an AI System, I want to generate key insights from analyzed conversations so that users can gain valuable information about their health and well-being.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a conversation, when the AI processes the text, then it should generate a set of key insights based on emotional, physical, and medical history analysis.
The key insights should be presented in a clear and concise manner, highlighting important findings and recommendations.
The AI should ensure that the key insights are actionable and relevant to the user's health context.

User Stories.Title: Real-time Analysis and Summarization
User Stories.Description: As an AI System, I want to perform real-time analysis and summarization of conversations so that users can receive immediate feedback and insights.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given an ongoing conversation, when the AI processes the text in real-time, then it should continuously analyze and update the summary and insights.
The real-time analysis should be efficient and not cause significant delays in the conversation flow.
The AI should ensure that the real-time analysis is accurate and provides meaningful insights as the conversation progresses.

User Stories.Title: Store and Retrieve Summarized Data
User Stories.Description: As an AI System, I want to store and retrieve summarized conversation data so that users can access their conversation summaries and insights at any time.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a summarized conversation, when the AI stores the data, then it should ensure that the summary and insights are securely saved in the database.
The stored data should be easily retrievable by users through their dashboards or profiles.
The AI should ensure that the stored data is encrypted and complies with data security and privacy regulations.

AI System.Title: AI Prompting for Doctors
AI System.Description: Allow doctors to prompt the AI agent associated with a patient to retrieve specific information or insights from the patient's conversation history. This will aid doctors in making informed decisions during consultations.

User Stories.Title: AI Prompt for Patient Medical History
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want to prompt the AI to retrieve the patient's medical history so that I can quickly review past medical conditions and treatments.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a patient is selected, when the doctor prompts the AI for medical history, then the AI retrieves and displays a summary of the patient's past medical conditions and treatments.
The AI should provide a concise summary of the patient's medical history within 5 seconds of the prompt.

User Stories.Title: AI Prompt for Recent Conversations
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want to prompt the AI to retrieve recent conversations with the patient so that I can understand the patient's current concerns and context.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a patient is selected, when the doctor prompts the AI for recent conversations, then the AI retrieves and displays the last three conversations with the patient.
The AI should highlight key points and concerns from the recent conversations.

User Stories.Title: AI Summarization of Patient Onboarding
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want to prompt the AI to summarize the patient's onboarding information so that I can quickly understand the patient's initial health status and concerns.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a patient is selected, when the doctor prompts the AI for onboarding summary, then the AI retrieves and displays a summary of the patient's onboarding responses.
The AI should include key health metrics and initial concerns raised during onboarding.

User Stories.Title: AI Retrieval of Consultation History
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want to prompt the AI to retrieve the patient's consultation history so that I can review previous consultations and their outcomes.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a patient is selected, when the doctor prompts the AI for consultation history, then the AI retrieves and displays a list of past consultations with summaries.
The AI should provide links to detailed consultation reports for further review.

User Stories.Title: AI Insights on Patient's Emotional Well-being
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want to prompt the AI to provide insights on the patient's emotional well-being based on conversation history so that I can address any mental health concerns.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a patient is selected, when the doctor prompts the AI for emotional well-being insights, then the AI analyzes conversation history and provides a summary of the patient's emotional state.
The AI should flag any significant changes or concerns in the patient's emotional well-being.

User Stories.Title: AI Analysis of Patient's Physical Symptoms
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want to prompt the AI to analyze the patient's conversation history for physical symptoms so that I can identify any recurring or new symptoms.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a patient is selected, when the doctor prompts the AI for physical symptoms analysis, then the AI scans the conversation history and lists any mentioned symptoms.
The AI should categorize symptoms by frequency and severity.

User Stories.Title: AI Generation of Patient Summary Report
User Stories.Description: As a doctor, I want to prompt the AI to generate a comprehensive summary report of the patient's health so that I can have a holistic view of the patient's condition.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a patient is selected, when the doctor prompts the AI for a summary report, then the AI compiles data from medical history, recent conversations, onboarding, and consultations into a single report.
The report should be generated within 10 seconds and be available for download or printing.

Patients.Title: User Authentication and Account Management
Patients.Description: Enable patients to securely register, log in, and manage their profile information. This includes email and phone OTP verification during registration and the ability to update profile details such as name, phone number, email, and profile picture.

User Stories.Title: Patient Registration with Email and Phone OTP Verification
User Stories.Description: As a patient, I want to register an account using my name, email, phone number, and password, so that I can securely access the platform.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I am on the registration page, when I enter my name, email, phone number, and password, then I should be able to submit the form.
Given that I have submitted the registration form, when I receive an OTP on my phone, then I should be able to enter the OTP to verify my phone number.
Given that I have submitted the registration form, when I receive an email with a verification link, then I should be able to click the link to verify my email.

User Stories.Title: Patient Login
User Stories.Description: As a patient, I want to log in using my registered email and password so that I can access my account.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I am on the login page, when I enter my registered email and password, then I should be able to submit the form to log in.
Given that I have entered valid credentials, when I click the login button, then I should be redirected to my dashboard.
Given that I have entered invalid credentials, when I click the login button, then I should see an error message indicating incorrect email or password.

User Stories.Title: Patient Profile Management - View Profile
User Stories.Description: As a patient, I want to view my profile information so that I can see my current details.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I am logged in, when I navigate to the profile page, then I should see my current name, phone number, email, and profile picture.

User Stories.Title: Patient Profile Management - Update Name
User Stories.Description: As a patient, I want to update my name so that my profile reflects my current information.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I am on the profile page, when I edit the name field, then I should be able to save the changes.
Given that I have saved the changes, when I refresh the profile page, then I should see the updated name.

User Stories.Title: Patient Profile Management - Update Phone Number
User Stories.Description: As a patient, I want to update my phone number so that my profile reflects my current contact information.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I am on the profile page, when I edit the phone number field, then I should be able to save the changes.
Given that I have saved the changes, when I refresh the profile page, then I should see the updated phone number.
Given that I have updated my phone number, when I save the changes, then I should receive an OTP to verify the new phone number.

User Stories.Title: Patient Profile Management - Update Email
User Stories.Description: As a patient, I want to update my email so that my profile reflects my current contact information.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I am on the profile page, when I edit the email field, then I should be able to save the changes.
Given that I have saved the changes, when I refresh the profile page, then I should see the updated email.
Given that I have updated my email, when I save the changes, then I should receive a verification email to confirm the new email address.

User Stories.Title: Patient Profile Management - Update Profile Picture
User Stories.Description: As a patient, I want to update my profile picture so that my profile reflects my current appearance.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given that I am on the profile page, when I upload a new profile picture, then I should be able to save the changes.
Given that I have saved the changes, when I refresh the profile page, then I should see the updated profile picture.

Patients.Title: AI-Guided Onboarding Process
Patients.Description: Provide an AI-guided onboarding process where patients can start a new visit, answer dynamic questions based on conversation context, and have their responses stored in a structured format. This process will generate a patient summary that can be viewed by both the patient and the doctor.

User Stories.Title: Start New Visit
User Stories.Description: As a patient, I want to start a new visit so that I can go through the AI-guided onboarding process.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the platform, when I click on the 'Start New Visit' button, then the AI-guided onboarding process should begin.
The AI should greet me and explain the onboarding process.
The AI should ask initial questions to gather basic information.

User Stories.Title: Dynamic Questioning
User Stories.Description: As a patient, I want the AI to ask me dynamic questions based on the conversation context so that the onboarding process feels personalized and relevant.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am in the onboarding process, when I provide an answer, then the AI should ask follow-up questions based on my previous responses.
The AI should be able to handle various types of responses and adjust its questions accordingly.

User Stories.Title: Store Responses
User Stories.Description: As a patient, I want my responses during the onboarding process to be stored in a structured format so that they can be used to generate a patient summary.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am answering questions during the onboarding process, when I submit a response, then the response should be stored in a structured format in the database.
All responses should be securely stored and encrypted.

User Stories.Title: Generate Patient Summary
User Stories.Description: As a patient, I want a summary of my onboarding responses to be generated so that I can review it and share it with my doctor.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I have completed the onboarding process, when the AI finishes asking questions, then a patient summary should be generated based on my responses.
The summary should be clear, concise, and include all relevant information gathered during the onboarding.

User Stories.Title: View Patient Summary
User Stories.Description: As a patient, I want to view my generated patient summary so that I can understand the information that will be shared with my doctor.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I have completed the onboarding process and a summary has been generated, when I navigate to the 'Visit History' tab, then I should be able to view my patient summary.
The summary should be easily accessible and readable.

User Stories.Title: Edit Profile Information
User Stories.Description: As a patient, I want to manage my profile information so that my details are always up-to-date.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the platform, when I navigate to the 'Profile Page', then I should be able to view and edit my profile information.
Changes to my profile should be saved and reflected immediately.

User Stories.Title: QR Code for Doctor Access
User Stories.Description: As a patient, I want to have a QR code that doctors can scan to access my visit and consultation histories so that I can easily share my medical information.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged into the platform, when I navigate to the 'Profile Page', then I should see a QR code.
When a doctor scans the QR code, they should be able to access my visit and consultation histories.

Patients.Title: Chat Interface with AI
Patients.Description: Implement a chat interface on the patient dashboard that allows patients to interact with an AI agent via text or voice. The AI will have access to the entire conversation history to provide informed responses, analyze conversations for emotional and physical well-being, and summarize long conversations.

User Stories.Title: Chat Interface Access
User Stories.Description: As a patient, I want to access the chat interface from my dashboard so that I can interact with the AI agent easily.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged in, when I navigate to my dashboard, then I should see a chat icon at the bottom right corner.
When I click on the chat icon, then the chat interface should open, allowing me to start a conversation with the AI agent.

User Stories.Title: Text Interaction with AI
User Stories.Description: As a patient, I want to interact with the AI agent via text so that I can ask questions and receive responses.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given the chat interface is open, when I type a message and press send, then the AI agent should respond with a relevant answer.
The AI agent should have access to my conversation history to provide informed responses.

User Stories.Title: Voice Interaction with AI
User Stories.Description: As a patient, I want to interact with the AI agent via voice so that I can communicate more naturally.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given the chat interface is open, when I click on the microphone icon and speak, then the AI agent should convert my speech to text and respond accordingly.
The AI agent should have access to my conversation history to provide informed responses.

User Stories.Title: Conversation History Access
User Stories.Description: As a patient, I want the AI agent to have access to my entire conversation history so that it can provide more accurate and informed responses.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I have previous conversations with the AI, when I start a new conversation, then the AI should be able to reference my past interactions to provide contextually relevant responses.

User Stories.Title: Conversation Summarization
User Stories.Description: As a patient, I want the AI agent to summarize long conversations so that I can easily review the key points.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a conversation exceeds a certain length, when I request a summary, then the AI agent should provide a concise summary of the main points discussed.
The summary should be stored in the database for future reference.

User Stories.Title: Emotional and Physical Well-being Analysis
User Stories.Description: As a patient, I want the AI agent to analyze my conversations for emotional and physical well-being so that I can receive insights into my health.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I have a conversation with the AI, when the conversation ends, then the AI should analyze the text for emotional and physical well-being indicators.
The analysis results should be displayed to me and stored in the database for future reference.

User Stories.Title: Data Storage
User Stories.Description: As a patient, I want all my conversations and summaries to be stored securely so that I can access them later.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I have a conversation with the AI, when the conversation ends, then the entire conversation and any generated summaries should be stored in the database.
The stored data should be encrypted to comply with Canadian Laws and Quebec Loi 25 laws.

Patients.Title: Viewing Historical Data
Patients.Description: Allow patients to view their past onboarding summaries and consultation histories. This includes providing a tab for onboarding history and another for consultation history, where patients can access detailed reports of their interactions and consultations.

User Stories.Title: View Onboarding History Tab
User Stories.Description: As a patient, I want to access a tab for onboarding history so that I can view summaries of my past onboarding sessions.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged in, when I navigate to the dashboard, then I should see a tab labeled 'Onboarding History'.
When I click on the 'Onboarding History' tab, I should see a list of my past onboarding sessions.
Each onboarding session should display a summary including the date and key details of the session.

User Stories.Title: View Detailed Onboarding Summary
User Stories.Description: As a patient, I want to view detailed reports of my past onboarding sessions so that I can review the information collected during those sessions.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am on the 'Onboarding History' tab, when I click on a specific onboarding session, then I should see a detailed report of that session.
The detailed report should include all questions asked and my responses during the onboarding session.

User Stories.Title: View Consultation History Tab
User Stories.Description: As a patient, I want to access a tab for consultation history so that I can view summaries of my past consultations with doctors.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am logged in, when I navigate to the dashboard, then I should see a tab labeled 'Consultation History'.
When I click on the 'Consultation History' tab, I should see a list of my past consultations.
Each consultation should display a summary including the date and key details of the consultation.

User Stories.Title: View Detailed Consultation Report
User Stories.Description: As a patient, I want to view detailed reports of my past consultations so that I can review the information discussed during those consultations.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given I am on the 'Consultation History' tab, when I click on a specific consultation, then I should see a detailed report of that consultation.
The detailed report should include the doctor's notes, AI-generated summaries, and any other relevant information from the consultation.

User Stories.Title: Secure Access to Historical Data
User Stories.Description: As a patient, I want to ensure that my historical data is securely accessible so that my privacy is maintained.
AcceptanceCriteria: All data should be encrypted in transit and at rest to comply with Canadian Laws and Quebec Loi 25 laws.
Access to historical data should be restricted to authenticated users only.
Sensitive information should not be displayed in URL parameters or other insecure methods.

User Stories.Title: User-Friendly Interface for Historical Data
User Stories.Description: As a patient, I want a user-friendly interface for viewing my historical data so that I can easily navigate and understand the information.
AcceptanceCriteria: The interface should be modern, sleek, and minimalistic.
Tabs for 'Onboarding History' and 'Consultation History' should be clearly labeled and easily accessible from the dashboard.
Summaries and detailed reports should be presented in a clear and organized manner.

Patients.Title: Profile Management and QR Code Access
Patients.Description: Enable patients to manage their profile information and generate a QR code that doctors can scan to access the patient's visit and consultation histories. This feature will be available on the patient's profile page.

User Stories.Title: Patient Profile Management
User Stories.Description: As a patient, I want to manage my profile information (name, phone number, email, and profile picture) so that I can keep my contact details up-to-date and personalize my account.
AcceptanceCriteria: Patients can view their current profile information.
Patients can edit and save changes to their name, phone number, email, and profile picture.
Changes to profile information are updated in the database and reflected immediately.

User Stories.Title: Generate QR Code for Profile
User Stories.Description: As a patient, I want to generate a QR code on my profile page so that doctors can scan it to access my visit and consultation histories.
AcceptanceCriteria: Patients can generate a unique QR code from their profile page.
The QR code links to the patient's visit and consultation histories.
The QR code is updated in real-time if any changes are made to the patient's visit or consultation histories.

User Stories.Title: View Visit History
User Stories.Description: As a patient, I want to view my visit history so that I can keep track of my past medical visits and summaries.
AcceptanceCriteria: Patients can access a 'Visit History' tab from their profile page.
The 'Visit History' tab displays a list of past visits with summaries.
Each visit summary includes the date, AI-generated summary, and any relevant notes.

User Stories.Title: View Consultation History
User Stories.Description: As a patient, I want to view my consultation history so that I can review past consultations with my doctors.
AcceptanceCriteria: Patients can access a 'Consultation History' tab from their profile page.
The 'Consultation History' tab displays a list of past consultations.
Each consultation entry includes the date, doctor's name, and a summary of the consultation.

User Stories.Title: Secure Data Access via QR Code
User Stories.Description: As a patient, I want to ensure that only authorized doctors can access my visit and consultation histories via the QR code so that my medical information remains private and secure.
AcceptanceCriteria: QR code access is restricted to authorized doctors who have scanned the code.
Doctors must log in to their accounts to access the patient's information via the QR code.
Patients receive a notification when their QR code is scanned and accessed by a doctor.

User Stories.Title: Profile Page Navigation
User Stories.Description: As a patient, I want an intuitive profile page layout so that I can easily navigate to manage my profile, view visit history, and view consultation history.
AcceptanceCriteria: The profile page includes clearly labeled sections for 'Profile Management', 'Visit History', and 'Consultation History'.
Navigation between sections is smooth and user-friendly.
The profile page design is consistent with the modern, sleek, and minimalistic UI guidelines.

User Stories.Title: Update Notification Settings
User Stories.Description: As a patient, I want to manage my notification settings so that I can control how and when I receive updates about my profile and medical histories.
AcceptanceCriteria: Patients can access notification settings from their profile page.
Patients can choose to receive notifications via email, SMS, or both.
Changes to notification settings are saved and applied immediately.

Patients.Title: Notifications and Alerts
Patients.Description: Send email notifications to patients for important actions such as registration, verification, and report approvals. This ensures that patients are kept informed about their account activities and medical updates.

User Stories.Title: Email Notification for Registration
User Stories.Description: As a patient, I want to receive an email notification upon successful registration so that I am aware that my account has been created.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a patient has successfully registered, when the registration process is complete, then an email notification is sent to the patient's registered email address.
The email should include a welcome message and confirmation of successful registration.

User Stories.Title: Email Notification for Email Verification
User Stories.Description: As a patient, I want to receive an email notification with a verification link so that I can verify my email address.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a patient has registered, when the registration process is complete, then an email notification containing a verification link is sent to the patient's registered email address.
The email should include instructions on how to verify the email address.

User Stories.Title: Email Notification for Phone OTP Verification
User Stories.Description: As a patient, I want to receive an email notification confirming my phone number verification so that I know my phone number has been successfully verified.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a patient has successfully verified their phone number using OTP, when the verification is complete, then an email notification is sent to the patient's registered email address.
The email should include a message confirming the successful verification of the phone number.

User Stories.Title: Email Notification for Report Approval
User Stories.Description: As a patient, I want to receive an email notification when a consultation report is approved by the doctor so that I am informed about the status of my medical reports.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given a doctor has approved a consultation report, when the approval process is complete, then an email notification is sent to the patient's registered email address.
The email should include details of the approved report and instructions on how to view it.

User Stories.Title: Email Notification for Account Activity
User Stories.Description: As a patient, I want to receive email notifications for any significant account activities so that I am kept informed about my account status.
AcceptanceCriteria: Given any significant account activity occurs (e.g., password change, profile update), when the activity is completed, then an email notification is sent to the patient's registered email address.
The email should include details of the activity and any necessary follow-up actions.
